detail: Male East Asian adult aged 32, a cool-headed methodical market analyst named DOYUN. Distinct from an athletic swaggering risk-taker: slender elegant build, refined long oval face, calm intelligent eyes behind thin dark round glasses, neat dark ash-brown side-parted hair, subtly warm reserved smile. Wearing an impeccably tailored deep cobalt-navy waistcoat over an ivory open-collar shirt, sleeves neatly rolled to the forearms, dark slate tailored trousers and a restrained silver wristwatch. No necktie, no lab coat. One hand lightly adjusting the opposite shirt cuff at waist height, fingers natural and fully visible. Upright composed posture, head gently turned toward the viewer, readable silhouette. Modern adult fashion-forward trader, no sci-fi details.
prompt:
Create a production game character sprite, a PNG CUTOUT WITH A REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. The canvas must contain only the person and transparency, absolutely NO opaque background, studio gradient, vignette, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, name card, border, halo or painted checkerboard. This is the most important technical requirement.
One original adult human character for CHART ARENA, a competitive chart prediction game. Art direction inspired by VALORANT agent illustrations: intentionally STYLIZED, sharply designed angular shapes, graphic block shadows, simplified planar face shapes, elegant hand-painted textures, strong readable silhouette, polished premium game key art. Not photoreal, not a doll, not chibi, not generic smooth 3D. Do not copy any existing game character. Not cyberpunk: NO neon light, NO glowing strips, NO implants, NO futuristic armor, NO weapons.
Consistent portrait sprite composition: vertical 2:3 canvas, centered head through upper thighs, head top at 7% canvas height, eye level at 17%, whole head, shoulders, elbows and hands entirely inside canvas. Adult human proportions, face about 15% of canvas height. Subject at most 80% canvas width. Calm, poised idle stance for subsequent animation. Neutral directional daylight upper left, cool soft fill, crisp silhouette with no floating glow. Modern fashion-forward trader, restrained charcoal and ivory base materials, one personality accent color.
